== Notes ==
* This skill can be used without [[Charm Animal]], [[Comfort Animal]] nor [[Heal as One]] equipped or when your [[animal companion]] is dead.
{{speed|5|15|25|15}}
* Animal companions already run faster than normal player speed so this may not be needed for the pet's benefit though it will still allow the pet to better catch a running target.
* This skill will continue to be active for the pet even if the owner has activated another stance after it.
* Consider using in combination with [[Feral Aggression]].

== Trivia ==
* The functionality of this skill has changed since its introduction; see its [[/Skill history|skill revision history]] for details.
